correctness.rationale: For \(2\le q<p\), every selected split of \((p+1)q\) has zero base-\(p\) carries because both low columns sum to \(q<p\). At \(q=p\), both low columns sum to \(p\), and the incoming carry in the second column forces exactly two carries total. Kummer's theorem therefore gives the stated valuations. Since \(r_p(p+1)=2\), the target row is extremal and all smaller admissible rows are not.
